repos_data.description: A developer CLI tool that manages .env files, detects secret leaks, syncs env drift across teammates, and validates environment parity between local/staging/prod  all from your terminal. Written in Go.
A framework for managing and maintaining multi-language pre-commit hooks.

Tamper-evident audit log for Go: an append-only, hash-chained, optionally Ed25519-signed log/slog handler, with offline logx verify. Built on the standard library, zero third-party dependencies. Also a full slog toolkit (colored output, JSON, rotation, fan-out, CLI).
Multi-String Pattern Matching Algorithm Using TrieNode
Software sandbox for storage of sensitive information in memory.

Triage for AI-generated code review: grades each changed diff line green/yellow/orange by impact, so reviewers spend attention where it matters. High-signal, low-noise (0 false blocks), deterministic — in your coding agent (MCP), editor (VS Code), and CLI/CI.

repo_meta_data.description: Statically compiled, zero-dependency Git pre-commit secret scanner and credentials detector written in Go. An alternative to Gitleaks and git-secrets.
